descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S19 Forced note failure on charts with no note, both contexts: Post-Round says 'Note not generated' with what to do next and nothing to copy; the dictation survives a reload

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T8a Note generation failed, Encounter side (TFA-94745 state 4): the typed dictation is kept, also after a reload, and an explicit message says the note was not generated and what to do next (retry), in H … (TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 6; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • T8b Note generation failed, Post-Round side (TFA-94745 state 4): the Note tab says the note was not generated ('Note not generated') and what to do next, not the plain 'No note generated yet' empty card; … (TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 6; UAT Empty & Failure States)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given A Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident with a saved pre-round and no note yet; every ai/notes:generateNote attempt fails (local stack only)

When Hospital: type the dictation on Encounter, tap Generate Note & Finish and wait until the screen settles (up to 60 s); open Post-Round (cp1); reload and open Encounter (cp2). Nursing Home: type the dictation, Generate, wait; Encounter as it is (cp3); Post-Round (cp4); reload and open Encounter (cp5)

Then Post-Round says the note was not generated and what to do next (retry), shows no note, no Copy to EMR or Copy Assessment & Plan, and no 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' once settled; the Nursing Home Encounter tab shows a failure message with a retry; the typed dictation is on Encounter after a reload in both contexts. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint. reqs are ungated, so a fabricated note, a copy control, a stuck 'Finalizing', a missing retry or a lost dictation is a plain Fail. The literal 'not generated' is a knownGap (Q5), so main reports Fail (known) until Q5 is answered. The failure runs on charts with no earlier note; a failure over an existing note is S27. …

Where it ran: dev; test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
